Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll typically find in a traditional lasagna recipe: | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Lasagna Noodles** | 9–12 sheets (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • Ground beef or Italian sausage (½–¾ lb)
• Onion, finely chopped (1 small)
• Garlic cloves, minced (2–3)
• Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce (28 oz can)
• Tomato paste (2 tbsp)
• Red wine (optional, ¼ cup)
• Dried oregano, basil, thyme (1 tsp each)
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • Ricotta cheese (15–16 oz)
• Egg (1, beaten)
• Grated Parmesan (¼ cup)
• Fresh parsley or basil, chopped (1 tbsp)
• Pinch of nutmeg (optional) | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • Shredded mozzarella (8–10 oz) | | **Parmesan Layer** | • Grated Parmesan (½–¾ cup) | | **Optional Extras** | • Spinach or kale (fresh or frozen, sautéed)
• Mushrooms (sliced)
• Bell peppers (diced)
• Carrots (grated)
• Zucchini (grated) | Feel free to adjust quantities based on your serving size or dietary preferences!
